units.instruction: Complete all five transformations. Each has two gaps, for ten scoring gaps. Keep all printed words; the brackets mark the owner to ask about.

materials.title: Music and a drawing
materials.text:
Five transformations, with two scoring gaps each. Read every original and its target sentence.

1. Join the two sentences without changing either person’s ability.
Original: Clara can play the violin. Owen can play the violin too.
Target: ____1____ Clara ____2____ Owen can play the violin.

2. Keep the same suggestion and the printed -ing phrase.
Original: Why not draw a forest?
Target: ____3____ ____4____ drawing a forest?

3. Keep affirmative is and the printed yours.
Original: My poster is not the same as yours.
Target: My poster is ____5____ ____6____ yours.

4. Ask about the owner marked in brackets; keep the printed item.
Original: Those are [Lena’s] boots.
Target: ____7____ boots ____8____ those?

5. Ask the speaker a yes/no question, changing I to you.
Original: I am in the nature club.
Target: ____9____ ____10____ in the nature club?

questions.prompt: Complete gap 1 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: Both with and joins two affirmative shared abilities. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 2 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: Both requires and for the two people. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 3 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: What about/How about both make the same suggestion before -ing. Why about is not that form. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 4 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: What/How about takes the printed -ing phrase. To does not form that suggestion. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 5 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: Affirmative is different preserves not the same meaning. Same would reverse it. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 6 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: Different from/to/than are accepted English variety choices. Of does not form this comparison. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 7 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: Whose asks ownership before the printed plural noun. Who/Who’s do not directly determine it. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 8 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: Plural those takes are. Is disagrees. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 9 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: You in a be-question takes Are. Is disagrees. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

questions.prompt: Complete gap 10 in the printed target sentence.
questions.explanation: Prompt explicitly changes speaker’s I to addressee you. I would not ask the speaker as required. Unlisted rewrites remain reviewable; accepted variants are not claimed exhaustive.

units.title: Twelve choices: journeys and home
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Twelve choices: journeys and home
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: Luca has a bicycle. ____ bicycle has a light on the front.
questions.explanation: His determines bicycle. Subject/object/reflexive do not determine this noun.

questions.prompt: The new sports hall opened ____ September.
questions.explanation: Month September takes in. On dates/days, at clock time and to direction do not fit.

questions.prompt: The road was closed, ____ we took another route.
questions.explanation: Closure causes alternative route, so. Because reverses cause, or alternative and although concession do not express stated result.

questions.prompt: This suitcase is much ____ than my old one.
questions.explanation: Much plus than requires comparative heavier, not positive/superlative.

questions.prompt:
—____ I bring the form today?
—No, you needn’t. Tomorrow is fine.
questions.explanation: Needn’t answers obligation Must. Permission/ability/willingness do not match this modal response.

questions.prompt:
—____ did you come to the museum?
—By underground.
questions.explanation: By underground answers travel method How. Time/reason/place do not.

questions.prompt: My brother usually ____ breakfast before seven.
questions.explanation: Usually present habit with singular brother takes has. Other forms disagree/change tense/aspect.

questions.prompt: Yesterday, we ____ the river by ferry.
questions.explanation: Yesterday establishes simple past crossed. Other choices present/future.

questions.prompt:
—Why didn’t you hear the doorbell at nine last night?
—I ____ the piano at that time.
questions.explanation: Ongoing action at past nine takes was practising. Others wrong tense.

questions.prompt: If the sky is clear tomorrow, we ____ the stars from the garden.
questions.explanation: Future real condition pairs present if with will watch. Past/perfect alternatives do not express tomorrow result.

questions.prompt: Of the four students, Anna explained the rule ____.
questions.explanation: Of four ranks superlative adverb most clearly. Comparative/adj/incomplete comparative do not fit.

questions.prompt: We are planning ____ our grandparents next weekend.
questions.explanation: Plan to visit uses infinitive. Base/-ing/past do not follow planning directly.

units.title: Twelve choices: a garden afternoon
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Twelve choices: a garden afternoon
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: Please give the spare gloves to Mia. I borrowed them from ____ yesterday.
questions.explanation: From takes object her. Subject/independent possessive/reflexive not appropriate owner object here.

questions.prompt: The gardening club meets ____ Friday afternoons.
questions.explanation: Named day afternoons take on. In general periods, at time, to direction do not fit.

questions.prompt: We stayed inside ____ the wind was too strong for the outdoor activity.
questions.explanation: Wind gives reason for indoor choice, because. Result/alternative/exception do not express this causal relation.

questions.prompt: The new watering can is ____ than the metal one.
questions.explanation: Than requires lighter comparative. Positive/superlative do not fit.

questions.prompt:
—Must every pupil bring a spade?
—No, you ____. The school has enough.
questions.explanation: No obligation is needn’t. Mustn’t prohibits, couldn’t inability, won’t future refusal/prediction.

questions.prompt:
—____ do the plants need moving?
—Because this corner gets too little light.
questions.explanation: Because reason answers Why. Other interrogatives ask location/count/time.

questions.prompt: Every spring, our teacher ____ new seeds for the club.
questions.explanation: Regular habit singular teacher buys. Base disagrees, past/progressive not habit form here.

questions.prompt: Last week, we ____ labels for all six pots.
questions.explanation: Last week past made. Other alternatives not past finite.

questions.prompt: At three yesterday, I ____ the leaves when the teacher arrived.
questions.explanation: Past ongoing activity interrupted by arrival takes was drawing. Others wrong temporal relation.

questions.prompt: If we finish early tomorrow, we ____ the equipment before going home.
questions.explanation: Future condition takes will clean result. Other choices past/perfect.

questions.prompt: Of all five groups, ours worked ____.
questions.explanation: All five groups establish superlative adverb. Comparative/adj/incomplete than form do not fit.

questions.prompt: The teacher asked us ____ the young plants gently.
questions.explanation: Asked us to carry uses infinitive. Other listed forms do not fit directly.

units.title: Ten choices: the school workshop
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Ten choices: the school workshop
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: This is ____ unusual design for ____ useful container.
questions.explanation: Unusual starts vowel sound, an; useful starts consonant /j/, a. Other combinations mismatch one/both.

questions.prompt: If the model ____ by the teacher, we will display it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Model receives approval in future condition, present passive is approved. Active/future/base past do not fit.

questions.prompt: Follow the ____ carefully; they tell you how to assemble each part.
questions.explanation: Instructions give assembly steps. Other nouns do not provide procedure.

questions.prompt: Please write ____ so the labels can be read from a distance.
questions.explanation: Clearly concerns legibility. Hardly/nearly/only do not express readable writing.

questions.prompt: This ruler ____ be Ali’s, but I am not sure. I will check.
questions.explanation: Uncertain possibility may. Must certainty/can’t impossibility/need obligation not tentative identification.

questions.prompt: We printed exactly ____ cards:199 plus one.
questions.explanation: Exact200 uses two hundred, no plural/of. Others malformed in this exact-number slot.

questions.prompt: ____ the first attempt failed, the group completed the model successfully later.
questions.explanation: Initial failure contrasts later success, concessive even though. Purpose/condition/time-until do not express stated contrast.

questions.prompt: Don’t ____ the wet paint. If you ____ it, you may leave a mark.
questions.explanation: Negative imperative base touch; real condition present touch. Other combinations wrong forms.

questions.prompt: A guide is someone ____ helps visitors understand a place.
questions.explanation: Person subject relative who. Whom object/which nonhuman/what without antecedent do not fit.

questions.prompt:
—Do you know ____?
—At half past four.
options: what time does the workshop end
questions.explanation: Embedded time question uses statement order ends. Others inverted/ungammatical/not asking supplied time.

units.title: Ten choices: preparing for a visit
units.instruction: Choose the best option for every complete sentence or short conversation.
units.alignmentNote: Complete twelve-item grade8 or ten-item grade9 four-option language-use set. Standalone sentences are kept in junior levels only; no senior Gaokao claim.

materials.title: Ten choices: preparing for a visit
materials.text: Read each sentence or short conversation in full. Choose one complete option per item.

questions.prompt: Our class chose ____ interesting activity in ____ university museum.
questions.explanation: Interesting vowel gives an; university initial /j/ gives a. Other pairs wrong sound-based articles.

questions.prompt: If permission ____ tomorrow, our group will visit the laboratory.
questions.explanation: Permission receives giving in present passive condition is given. Active/future/past forms wrong structure.

questions.prompt: The notice gives clear ____ to the museum entrance, including two turns.
questions.explanation: Directions tell route/turns. Other nouns do not guide navigation.

questions.prompt: The guide spoke ____ enough for everyone to hear each word.
questions.explanation: Clearly plus enough concerns intelligibility. Other adverbs do not express it.

questions.prompt: The closed door ____ lead to the office, but let’s ask before entering.
questions.explanation: Tentative possible destination may. Must certainty/can’t impossibility/need obligation do not fit uncertainty.

questions.prompt: The collection contains exactly ____ postcards, not399.
questions.explanation: Exact400 is four hundred without plural/of. Other numerical forms malformed.

questions.prompt: ____ the journey took longer than expected, we still arrived before the tour began.
questions.explanation: Unexpected delay despite timely arrival forms concession although. Purpose/exception/until not this contrast.

questions.prompt: Don’t ____ your ticket. If you ____ it, ask the teacher for help.
questions.explanation: Imperative base lose and real-condition present lose. Other pairs wrong forms.

questions.prompt: The volunteer ____ showed us the room answered our questions too.
questions.explanation: Human subject relative who. Other relative forms do not fit subject antecedent.

questions.prompt:
—Could you tell me ____?
—At the north gate.
questions.explanation: Place answer requires embedded where with statement order. Inversion/time/whether-inverted wrong.
